questions.question: Why is Satoru Gojo known as the strongest jujutsu sorcerer within the modern jujutsu society?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo

answer.item: Satoru Gojo is known as the strongest jujutsu sorcerer within the modern jujutsu society. He earned this alias in part due to the immense amounts of cursed energy he possesses.

questions.question: What did Gojo do throughout his fight with Sukuna without ever showing signs of exhausting his reserves?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo

answer.item: Throughout his fight with Sukuna, Gojo used cursed energy to constantly reinforce himself and activate his cursed techniques multiple times, without ever showing signs of exhausting his reserves.

questions.question: What gives Satoru Gojo excellent control over cursed energy?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo

answer.item: Gojo has excellent control over his cursed energy due to the Six Eyes.

questions.question: How versatile is Satoru Gojo's control over cursed energy?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo

answer.item: He is capable of expanding his domain for a split second, using reverse cursed technique, and simultaneously activating and controlling multiple Blues and Reds.

questions.question: Why does Gojo give the impression that he never runs out of cursed energy?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo

answer.item: Additionally, Gojo has extraordinary cursed energy efficiency. When using cursed techniques, Gojo suffers almost zero unnecessary cursed energy loss. As a result, he spends less cursed energy compared to other sorcerers during combat, giving the impression that he never runs out of cursed energy.

questions.question: What does Satoru Gojo keep activated at all times while using reverse cursed technique to heal his brain?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo

answer.item: This allows him to keep Limitless activated at all times while constantly using reverse cursed technique to heal his brain to prevent fatigue

questions.question: What can Gojo output into his techniques to augment their effects?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo

answer.item: In addition to his immense cursed energy capacity, Gojo can output high amounts of cursed energy into his techniques to augment their effects.

questions.question: How did Gojo counter Jogo and Hanami's strategy to neutralize his Infinity?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo

answer.item: By strengthening the output into his Limitless technique, Gojo countered Jogo and Hanami's strategy to neutralize his Infinity with domain amplification, expanding the size of Infinity to the point that he could even push back and crush Hanami against a wall with the barrier.

questions.question: How can Gojo increase the cursed energy output of his techniques?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo

answer.item: By deliberately including the incantations and hand signs of his cursed techniques, Gojo can increase their cursed energy output.

questions.question: What was Gojo already skilled at when he was a second-year student, and how did he use it when Toji stabbed through his chest?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo

answer.item: Even when he was a second-year student, Gojo was already skilled at reinforcing his body with cursed energy. When Toji stabbed through his chest with a sword, Gojo reinforced his cursed energy so that the sword couldn't do further damage, causing the injury to hardly affect him during their first battle.

questions.question: How can adult Gojo use cursed energy to increase his physical strength?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo

answer.item: As an adult, Gojo can strengthen himself with cursed energy to vastly increase his physical strength or fortify his body.

questions.question: What are many of Gojo's feats of strength and speed attributed to?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo

answer.item: Many of his aforementioned feats of strength and speed can be attributed to his skill in reinforcement techniques.

questions.question: What could Gojo do with cursed energy reinforcement and hand-to-hand combat alone?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo

answer.item: With cursed energy reinforcement and hand-to-hand combat alone, Gojo was able to overwhelm two special grade cursed spirits. In several instances, single strikes from Gojo were strong enough to either launch his opponents a fair distance away or pierce through them.

questions.question: What is Black Flash, and what does it do to a strike's destructive power?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo

answer.item: A phenomenon that occurs when the user applies cursed energy within 0.000001 seconds of a physical hit, creating a spatial distortion that causes their cursed energy to flash black and amplifies the destructive power of the strike to the power of 2.5.

questions.question: How did Satoru Gojo first demonstrate Black Flash?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo

answer.item: Satoru first demonstrated his ability to use Black Flash against Sukuna during their battle in Shinjuku, dealing a devastating strike when the King of Curses least expected it and knocking him unconscious.

questions.question: How does Gojo compare to Kento Nanami and Yuji Itadori in Black Flash usage?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo

answer.item: Gojo has used Black Flash more times than Kento Nanami but less times consecutively, though his record was eventually surpassed by Yuji Itadori.
